info.desc: Sticky Fingers is the ninth British and 11th American studio album by English rock band The Rolling Stones, released in April 1971. It is the band's first album of the 1970s and its first release on the band's newly formed label, Rolling Stones Records, after having been contracted since 1963 with Decca Records in the UK and London Records in the US. It is also Mick Taylor's first full-length appearance on a Rolling Stones album, the first Rolling Stones album not to feature any contributions from guitarist and founder Brian Jones and the first one on which singer Mick Jagger .

podcast.body: Released on April 23, 1971, this album was the first to feature the iconic "Lips and Tongue" logo, designed by John Pasche for 50 pounds. It became one of the most recognizable pieces of rock and roll art and was extensively used on merchandise. "The first record to feature the famous Lipson Tung logo. It's one of the most recognizable pieces of rock and roll art ever."
